--src: Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.AdjMatrix
/-- If `A` is qualified as an adjacency matrix,
    then the adjacency matrix of the graph induced by `A` is itself. -/
theorem adjMatrix_toGraph_eq [DecidableEq α] : h.toGraph.adjMatrix α = A := by
  ext i j
  obtain h' | h' := h.zero_or_one i j <;> simp [h']

--src: Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Block
@[simp]
theorem fromBlocks_diagonal (d₁ : l → α) (d₂ : m → α) :
    fromBlocks (diagonal d₁) 0 0 (diagonal d₂) = diagonal (Sum.elim d₁ d₂) := by
  ext i j
  rcases i with ⟨⟩ <;> rcases j with ⟨⟩ <;> simp [diagonal]

--src: Mathlib.Data.List.MinMax
theorem argmax_concat (f : α → β) (a : α) (l : List α) :
    argmax f (l ++ [a]) =
      Option.casesOn (argmax f l) (some a) fun c => if f c < f a then some a else some c := by
  rw [argmax, argmax]; simp [argAux]

  rw [← Matrix.diagonal_one, Matrix.diagonal_neg, Matrix.fromBlocks_diagonal]
  rfl
